package module

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateModuleInput holds data for a module.
type CreateModuleInput struct {
	ID               string
	SourceKey        string
	TechID           *int
	Status           *int
	Visibility       *int
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess
	Translations     []domain.ModuleI18n
}

// CreateModule creates an independent reusable module.
type CreateModule struct {
	Modules    repository.ModuleRepository
	ModuleI18n repository.ModuleI18nRepository
	Techs      repository.TechRepository
	I18n       repository.I18nRepository
	Tx         repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc CreateModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateModuleInput) (domain.Module, error) {
	var module domain.Module
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		moduleID := strings.TrimSpace(in.ID)
		if moduleID == "" {
			moduleID = uuid.NewString()
		} else if _, err := uuid.Parse(moduleID); err != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if in.TechID != nil && *in.TechID > 0 && uc.Techs != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Techs.GetByID(ctx, *in.TechID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		status := domain.ModuleStatusActive
		if in.Status != nil {
			status = *in.Status
		}
		visibility := domain.ModuleVisibilityStandalone
		if in.Visibility != nil {
			visibility = *in.Visibility
		}
		if !isValidModuleVisibility(visibility) {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		sourceKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(in.SourceKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		module = domain.Module{
			ID:               moduleID,
			SourceKey:        sourceKey,
			TechID:           in.TechID,
			Status:           status,
			Visibility:       visibility,
			LessonReadAccess: in.LessonReadAccess,
			CreatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
			UpdatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := uc.Modules.Create(ctx, module); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if uc.ModuleI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range normalizeModuleTranslations(in.Translations) {
				if uc.I18n != nil {
					if _, err := uc.I18n.GetByID(ctx, translation.I18nID); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				translation.ModuleID = module.ID
				if err := uc.ModuleI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.Module{}, err
	}
	return module, nil
}
